payout.title: Payout
payout.intro: Set up payments so your widget can receive tips.

balance.title: Balance
balance.pending: {amount} on its way, available in a few days.
balance.belowMinimum: {missing} more to go before you can pay out (minimum {minimum}).
balance.paidOut: {amount} is on its way to your bank account.
balance.errorBelowMinimum: Your available balance is below the minimum. Try again once it has grown.

payout.countryHint: Where you or your business is based. This cannot be changed later.
payout.siteUrlHint: The address the widget runs on. Payments are only accepted from this site and your hosted page. No website? Leave it empty and share your hosted page instead.
payout.siteUrlInvalid: Enter a valid site address, for example example.com
payout.currencyHint: Supporters are charged in this currency. It follows your country unless you change it.
payout.detailsIncomplete: Pick your country and currency before you continue.
payout.editHint: Your country and business type are fixed on your payment account and cannot be changed.

issues.verificationFailed: These details could not be verified. Check them for typos and try again, or upload a document when asked.
issues.invalidInformation: Some of these details were not accepted. Check them and try again.
issues.needsAttention: This needs another look before it can be approved.

details.title: Your details
details.todo: Tell us where you are based, what you collect in, and where the widget runs. We use these to open your payment account.

identity.title: Start receiving tips
identity.todo: Give your details and a bank account, and complete a short identity check.
identity.pending: Your details are being verified. Your widget goes live as soon as this clears.
identity.done: Your widget can receive card tips.

localMethods.title: Enable local payment methods
localMethods.todo: Let supporters pay the way they already do: iDEAL, Bancontact, EPS, Revolut Pay and more. iDEAL asks sole proprietors for a tax identification number.
localMethods.pending: Your request is being reviewed. Card payments already work in the meantime.
localMethods.done: Supporters can pay with the local methods available where they are.
localMethods.unavailable: Local payment methods are not available for accounts in your country.

payouts.title: Get paid out
payouts.todo: Add a bank account to receive what you collect. Tips already collected stay in your balance until then.
payouts.pending: Your bank account is being verified.
payouts.done: Payouts to your bank account are active.

payout.bannerReturn: Thanks. We are checking your setup.
payout.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
payout.errorNotConfigured: Payments are not set up yet. Please try again later.
payout.errorLocalMethodsUnavailable: Local payment methods are not available for accounts in your country.
payout.errorSiteNotConfigured: Fill in your details above before you set up payments.
